newsitem.title: TAIWAN: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - January 28.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - January 28.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Taiwan press on Tuesday. Reuter has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
CHINA TIMES - Former provincial assemblymen Miao Su-fan and Chou Hsi-man detained for alleged involvement in highway construction project scandal.
Some T$30 million (US$1.1 million) robbed in a hypermarket in central Taichung.
UNITED DAILY NEWS - Council for Economic Planning and Development says it's certain that economy is recovering.
Zen master Miao Tien prosecuted on charges of fraud.
LIBERTY TIMES - First nuclear waste shipment scheduled to ship to North Korea in one month.
More people detained as Chungshan Highway scandal widens.
COMMERCIAL TIMES - Taiwan and Cambodia to start air links in March.
Top economic policymaker Chiang Pin-kung to lure Japanese firms to invest in southern Tainan industrial park.
ECONOMIC DAILY NEWS - Index of leading indicators rise for fourth straight month in December, indicating steady recovery.
U.S. grain suppliers plan to station in Taichung harbour.
